# scc_dlp_compliance_policy (Resource)

Manages the DlpCompliancePolicy object via New-DlpCompliancePolicy / Get-DlpCompliancePolicy / Set-DlpCompliancePolicy / Remove-DlpCompliancePolicy. List attributes that only New-DlpCompliancePolicy takes (endpoint_dlp_location, endpoint_dlp_location_exception, exchange_location, on_premises_scanner_dlp_location, on_premises_scanner_dlp_location_exception, one_drive_location, one_drive_location_exception, power_bi_dlp_location, power_bi_dlp_location_exception, share_point_location, share_point_location_exception, teams_location, teams_location_exception, third_party_app_dlp_location, third_party_app_dlp_location_exception) are updated in place through Set-DlpCompliancePolicy -Add<X>/-Remove<X>. auto_enable_after, start_simulation can only be set by Set-DlpCompliancePolicy; on create they are applied right after New-DlpCompliancePolicy. A refresh keeps the configured value when the service returns an equivalent one: JSON values compare by content, ignoring formatting, key order and (except advanced_rule) keys the service adds; lists and enumerations case-insensitively, locations by any of their identities.
